purpose: Define controlled candidate models for baseline improvement.
selection_principles: Evaluate only on the 2024 validation dataset.
Do not use the 2025/26 final test set.
Do not modify the existing baseline artifact.

candidates.name: Scaled Logistic Regression
candidates.reason: Addresses feature-scale differences and the observed Logistic Regression convergence warning.

candidates.name: Regularized Logistic Regression
candidates.reason: Tests whether stronger regularization improves generalization and probability quality.

candidates.name: Random Forest
candidates.reason: Provides a non-linear comparison against the linear baseline.

selection_rule: Select a candidate only after comparing all candidates against the frozen baseline using the identical 2024 validation set. No candidate may be selected using the 2025/26 final test set.
